description: Generate a QR code as a PNG or SVG: POST the text or URL to encode (with an optional size from 64 to 2048px) and get back the image. Useful for any "scan to view" moment — signage, business cards, slides — or to encode a public wallet address for x402 funding and top-ups.

_signals.x_guidance:
Generate a QR code as a PNG or SVG: POST the text or URL to encode (with an optional size from 64 to 2048px) and get back the image. Useful for any "scan to view" moment — signage, business cards, slides — or to encode a public wallet address for x402 funding and top-ups.

POST a JSON body to https://qr.wdh.sh/. Payment is settled in USDC on Base via x402.
